title: Ultrabericus Marathon 45K: 46.7km / 1,437m D+
terrain: Vicenza, Piazza dei Signori, start 10:00, counter-clockwise, cut-offs km 11.6 12:10 / km 24.4 14:10 / km 36 16:10
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: first 90min cap 155bpm. Hike the 20% wall at km 18.8. From Torri di Arcugnano (km 36) open up.
GYM: none.
FUEL: breakfast 07:00, 100-120g carb. ~70g carb/h: Tailwind + gels, refill at all 3 aid stations.
STOP RULE: knee or calf signal = hike-run, finish.
WHY: 5h15-5h45 comes from an even first half.
